findings.reason: the anchor names the wrong branches, so the refusal lands where the section did not mean to add one and not where it must.
findings.text: the comments-branch anchor "the comments branch of `_apply_append` (near lines 3798–3807)" does not resolve: lines 3798–3807 are the `research` and `questions` branches of `_apply_append` (reckon/_store.py:3791–3810), and the comments branch that writes `data.comments[section]` is reckon/_store.py:3811–3821, so a worker adding the refusal at the cited lines refuses research and question bodies and leaves comments — the site done-when case three asserts — unchecked

findings.reason: the anchor points at a prompt-only branch and the write that must refuse sits in a module the section does not grant, so the case-four gate is unreachable without a scope change.
findings.text: the anchor "the followups.<id>.<field> set (near lines 3482–3486)" resolves to the `followups.<id>.prompt` branch (reckon/_store.py:3482–3496), not the body set: the general field-set branch is line 3495 and it delegates to `apply_followup_field_set` (reckon/_store_section_ops.py:362–388), which assigns `working["followups"][index] = {**followup, field: value}` with no deferred-work check, so done-when case four's `followups.<id>.body` case needs the guard at line 3495 in `reckon/_store.py` or inside `apply_followup_field_set`, and the latter module is not among §3's declared write paths

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: two findings — the `_apply_append` comments-branch anchor resolves to the research and questions branches, and the followups field-set anchor resolves to the prompt branch rather than the body set.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the seven cases each name a negative control, the controls cover the case list one for one, and the followup body-set case is measurable provided the second anchors_resolve finding is corrected.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — every log is required under the run directory, headed by its revision and the literal command and ending in `EXIT=`, so nothing lands in a node-local temporary path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — `_DEFERRED_WORK_TERM`, `_prose_deferred_work_term` and `tests/test_every_spelling_of_deferred_work_is_read.py` name the mechanism; no plan labels, stage names or ticket numbers reach them.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the root cause matches §1's evidence (the regex is one spelling today), the mechanism produces each done-when case, and every refusal site is named with the caller that reaches it.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §3's one deliverable is that the deferred-work rule reads every spelling on every comment and followup body, and its gate closes on that alone.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — `plan-section-depends-on` gives s3 a wait on `an-evidence-record-counts-only-what-it-read#s2`, the section whose write path s3 shares, and no declared relationship points at a node that does not exist.
